corrections.text: The headline's second clause, 'No Fix Is Coming for a Reported Puppeteer Flaw', is not attributed in the headline. It rests on Help Net Security's account that the maintainers replied the server is archived and unmaintained, 'so no fix will come from that repository', and on the archive README's statement that 'No security updates or bug fixes will be provided'. The Herald did not see Glow Labs' report or the maintainers' reply, and Help Net Security does not repeat the word Puppeteer in the sentence about the closed report.

The article says a GitHub issue 'predates the Glow Labs report'. The issue was opened on September 9, 2026 (UTC), before Help Net Security's November 3 article on Glow Labs' research. None of the cited sources says when Glow Labs reported the flaw to the maintainers, so the article does not establish whether the issue came before or after that report.
